Iteration intervals include pipeline backpressure from an earlier submitted frame; per-frame build-to-observed-completion latency is never converted to FPS. data.scope: B3 whole-renderer reference on one machine, not isolated RenderGraph overhead or pixel parity. Both B3 profiles explicitly disable the packed source AO channel while preserving source bytes/materials. Renderer: Neutral, post-tonemap FXAA, consumer IBL cook, offscreen. Godot: native AgX, pre-tonemap FXAA, RGBE-quantized panorama and native BRDF/prefilter/PCF/depth-prepass/batching/presentation. identity.contract: Forward+ Vulkan release template; runtime glTF full exterior; generated tangents and PNG mipmaps; no LOD/occlusion, optional frustum culling; windowed 1080p vsync off; fixed frame-indexed route. B2 retains authored AO, constant ambient .03, no IBL/shadow/AA, linear exposure1. conditions.purpose: Pinned B0 exterior composition and later two-API acceptance inputs. CPU preview is not runtime reference ground truth.

coordinate_system.projection: Perspective, vertical FOV; logical top-left output; normal-Z zero-to-one depth (near 0, far 1); backend conversion must preserve rays and front faces.

views.name: overview
views.purpose: Whole exterior fits camera frustum with margin; target is a virtual aim point below ground, not a camera position. Occlusion still applies.

views.name: street
views.purpose: Street, sun/shadow boundary, building materials and foliage.

views.name: material-detail
views.purpose: Vespa, normal/roughness and pavement near-field detail.

views.name: glass-detail
views.purpose: Alpha-zero glass and curtains behind; no diagnostic fill.

views.name: label-detail
views.purpose: Alpha-zero labels and bottle behind; no diagnostic fill.

route.interpolation: Linear position, target and vertical FOV between named keyframes, +Y look-at up.
route.collision: No collision or walking-physics requirement; composition/clearance audit recorded separately.

ambient_occlusion.policy: Bistro comparison profile follows Falcor 4.0.1's default-disabled occlusion map. Preserve all source ORM texels and material references; disable only their lighting contribution at the consumer creation boundary.

sun.units: Scene-linear benchmark irradiance; not measured lux or calibrated daylight.

preprocess.formula: c=max(decoded linear RGB,0); L=dot(c,coefficients); c*=min(1,cap/max(L,1e-20)); source texels before resampling/prefilter, then strength. Bright-source suppression, not physical sun removal.

ibl.mapping: u=fract(0.5+atan2(direction.z,direction.x)/(2*pi)); v=acos(clamp(direction.y,-1,1))/pi; source top row v=0; sample inverse R_y(yaw)*direction; repeat U, clamp V.
ibl.prefilter: B3 generates diffuse irradiance, roughness-dependent specular and BRDF integration from processed source; tool and output hashes fixed before B3 acceptance.

output.order: Linear HDR -> external Bloom if enabled -> multiply by 2^exposure_ev -> PBR Neutral -> sRGB OETF exactly once -> RGB8 round nearest, alpha 1.
output.background: Constant camera-visible background, processed with same exposure/tone/sRGB; IBL stays visible to illumination and reflections.

preview.note: Cycles CPU composition/exposure diagnostic with denoised visualization and separately retained noisy EXR; not matching runtime PBR/IBL/CSM/Bloom/AA. No native depth/shadow acceptance or performance claims.
preview.denoiser: OpenImageDenoise, CPU compositor, accurate HDR with normal/albedo guides; independent noisy EXR retained

runtime_quality.pbr: Metallic-roughness GGX and Lambert diffuse with normal maps; audited AO/alpha/double-sided recipe retained. Details fixed with selected B0 foundation.
runtime_quality.shadow: CSM+PCF starting profile: 4 cascades, 2048 square each, distance 120m, practical split lambda .6, 3x3 PCF, texel snapping, last 10% blend. Bias calibrated B3 before acceptance.
runtime_quality.hdr: RGBA16F starting profile; actual format usages checked on both APIs.
runtime_quality.aa: FXAA starting profile after tone mapping before sRGB, AA-off diagnostics; parameters fixed/calibrated B3.
runtime_quality.bloom: External effect on for B5 final output, bypass also saved; threshold/knee/radius/strength fixed B4 before acceptance.

acceptance.scope: Full exterior, no mesh/material silently omitted. Indoor/GI/path tracing/native HDR display not required.
acceptance.cpu_preview: Composition/exposure only. Runtime image thresholds cannot derive from these noisy previews.
acceptance.gpu_comparison: Optimized strict-validation and optimized no-diagnostics/no-native-validation runs; Vulkan/D3D12 sequential on Windows RTX3060. Save SDR, pre-Bloom HDR, depth, shadow and Bloom bypass at named views and scheduled route frames.
acceptance.threshold_calibration: Before each acceptance: same API >=3 repeats, both APIs and known material/sRGB/alpha/shadow errors; freeze absolute/relative RGB/HDR, differing-pixel count and named ROI thresholds with settings hash. Retain edge pixels, fail shape/NaN/inf. Numeric thresholds await B2/B3/B5 GPU calibration.
acceptance.performance: Cold first-load separate; 2 complete 1800-frame warm-up tours then 3 measured 1800-frame tours at 60Hz logical time (30s scene time each; wall duration is measured, not forced to 30s). Offscreen VSync off; raw samples and per-run p50/p95, no fixed FPS budget before RTX3060 measurement. CPU build/compile/record/submit/retire, GPU timestamps, frame wall time, memory residency/high-water/budget; present/VSync measured separately.
acceptance.alpha_note: Label view remains naturally dark with no interior/fill lighting. Its CPU color preview is not evidence of zero depth/shadow coverage; require explicit GPU depth/shadow and opaque-override sensitivity fixtures in B2/B3.

profile.name: godot-b3-repeat
profile.calibration: Pre-formal B3 pilot: four changed pixels, each one RGB code; cap=4x observed pixel count. Freeze before formal runs; a formal failure requires investigation, not a fitted tolerance.

data.scope: Godot renderer reference for the explicitly archived B2/B3 profile, not isolated RenderGraph overhead or pixel parity with Renderer. B3 retains native Godot AgX, pre-tonemap FXAA, BRDF/prefilter/shadow-filter differences versus Renderer Neutral/post-tonemap FXAA. CPU = setup + viewport, excludes scripts/physics/process-wide CPU; GPU = viewport observed query. Frame intervals = post-draw callback gaps, not scanout. Query observations may lag route frame numbers. Timers off/on are independent processes; differences include run variability. Godot memory monitors are not residency or allocation event counts; static_memory_bytes=0 is an unavailable release counter, not zero memory use.

limits: Whole-renderer reference with Neutral/AgX, IBL/BRDF/PCF, FXAA ordering, culling/prepass/batching and presentation differences; not isolated RenderGraph overhead or pixel parity.
Active host elapsed includes polling and OS descheduling, excludes explicit yield; charged CPU, iteration interval, GPU timestamp and completion latency are separate.
Strict/native diagnostics and memory instrumentation are separate artifacts from ordinary performance.
Earlier AO-enabled diagnostic pilots are excluded from final scene/image/performance acceptance.
No physical VRAM residency, native OOM/device-loss injection, other hardware, long soak, Bloom/B4, scanout/input latency, B5 window interaction or temporal shimmer-free guarantee.
AgX addition and recalibration are deferred to renderer-5io after speed improvements.

Calibrated 3.0ms CPU/5.5ms GPU references are worst-run Godot p95 rounded up0.5ms for this controlled cohort. Godot CPU p95 still ranges1.895-2.992ms. P99 baseline is met offscreen, individual hitches and120FPS stretch remain; no actual-display guarantee.

data.scope: B3 whole-renderer reference on one machine, not isolated RenderGraph overhead or pixel parity. Godot: native AgX, pre-tonemap FXAA, RGBE-quantized panorama and native BRDF/prefilter/PCF/depth-prepass/batching/presentation. Engine counters and planned Graph draws are distinct. Iteration intervals include pipeline backpressure from an earlier submitted frame; per-frame build-to-observed-completion latency is never converted to FPS. Neither engine measures scanout/input latency. GPU correctness, final resource release, zero allocation and B5 window/interaction acceptance are separate. CPU affinity/QoS is declared in cpu_policy; a controlled CPU subset is distinct from the default scheduler.

Godot's BRDF, prefilter, shadow filter, depth prepass, batching, mip chain and presentation differ from Renderer; AgX and pre-tonemap FXAA differ from Renderer Neutral and post-tonemap FXAA.

prepared.scope: packed logical resource bytes and prepared copy budgets; not actual native allocation size or VRAM residency

vulkan-gpu-off-3.setup_scope: combined asset/conditions load, boundary validation, native resource/pipeline preparation, upload/CPU input release, frame storage and warmup; checkpoints exclude some reporting/bookkeeping; outside measured frame ROI

recipe.diffuse_storage: irradiance E; shader divides by pi

panorama.quantization: RGBE shared-exponent, floor channels; separate from raw RGBA16F IBL

identity.contract: Forward+ Vulkan release template; runtime glTF full exterior; generated tangents, uncompressed ImageTexture material images; no LOD/occlusion, optional frustum culling; windowed 1080p vsync off; fixed frame-indexed route. B2 retains base-only PNG images, authored AO, constant ambient .03, no IBL/shadow/AA, linear exposure1. B3 explicitly generates full PNG mip chains before warmup, renormalizing only normal-map coarser levels, and verifies actual native readbacks, base bytes and shared material references. Renderer retains authored DDS mip chains; Godot generated mip pixels are not equivalent. B3 disables source AO maps while retaining all source bytes/materials; cap4 static IBL strength3, four 2048-effective CSM splits/PCF/no PCSS, native AgX exposure2 and FXAA, no Bloom/extra effects. Godot's BRDF, prefilter, shadow filter, depth prepass, batching, mip chain and presentation differ from Renderer; AgX and pre-tonemap FXAA differ from Renderer Neutral and post-tonemap FXAA.

conditions.purpose: Pinned B0 exterior composition and later two-API acceptance inputs. CPU preview is not runtime reference ground truth.

coordinate_system.projection: Perspective, vertical FOV; logical top-left output; normal-Z zero-to-one depth (near 0, far 1); backend conversion must preserve rays and front faces.

views.name: overview
views.purpose: Whole exterior fits camera frustum with margin; target is a virtual aim point below ground, not a camera position. Occlusion still applies.

views.name: street
views.purpose: Street, sun/shadow boundary, building materials and foliage.

views.name: material-detail
views.purpose: Vespa, normal/roughness and pavement near-field detail.

views.name: glass-detail
views.purpose: Alpha-zero glass and curtains behind; no diagnostic fill.

views.name: label-detail
views.purpose: Alpha-zero labels and bottle behind; no diagnostic fill.

route.interpolation: Linear position, target and vertical FOV between named keyframes, +Y look-at up.
route.collision: No collision or walking-physics requirement; composition/clearance audit recorded separately.

ambient_occlusion.policy: Bistro comparison profile follows Falcor 4.0.1's default-disabled occlusion map. Preserve all source ORM texels and material references; disable only their lighting contribution at the consumer creation boundary.

sun.units: Scene-linear benchmark irradiance; not measured lux or calibrated daylight.

preprocess.formula: c=max(decoded linear RGB,0); L=dot(c,coefficients); c*=min(1,cap/max(L,1e-20)); source texels before resampling/prefilter, then strength. Bright-source suppression, not physical sun removal.

ibl.mapping: u=fract(0.5+atan2(direction.z,direction.x)/(2*pi)); v=acos(clamp(direction.y,-1,1))/pi; source top row v=0; sample inverse R_y(yaw)*direction; repeat U, clamp V.
ibl.prefilter: B3 generates diffuse irradiance, roughness-dependent specular and BRDF integration from processed source; tool and output hashes fixed before B3 acceptance.

output.order: Linear HDR -> external Bloom if enabled -> multiply by 2^exposure_ev -> PBR Neutral -> sRGB OETF exactly once -> RGB8 round nearest, alpha 1.
output.background: Constant camera-visible background, processed with same exposure/tone/sRGB; IBL stays visible to illumination and reflections.

preview.note: Cycles CPU composition/exposure diagnostic with denoised visualization and separately retained noisy EXR; not matching runtime PBR/IBL/CSM/Bloom/AA. No native depth/shadow acceptance or performance claims.
preview.denoiser: OpenImageDenoise, CPU compositor, accurate HDR with normal/albedo guides; independent noisy EXR retained

runtime_quality.pbr: Metallic-roughness GGX and Lambert diffuse with normal maps; audited AO/alpha/double-sided recipe retained. Details fixed with selected B0 foundation.
runtime_quality.shadow: CSM+PCF starting profile: 4 cascades, 2048 square each, distance 120m, practical split lambda .6, 3x3 PCF, texel snapping, last 10% blend. Bias calibrated B3 before acceptance.
runtime_quality.hdr: RGBA16F starting profile; actual format usages checked on both APIs.
runtime_quality.aa: FXAA starting profile after tone mapping before sRGB, AA-off diagnostics; parameters fixed/calibrated B3.
runtime_quality.bloom: External effect on for B5 final output, bypass also saved; threshold/knee/radius/strength fixed B4 before acceptance.

acceptance.scope: Full exterior, no mesh/material silently omitted. Indoor/GI/path tracing/native HDR display not required.
acceptance.cpu_preview: Composition/exposure only. Runtime image thresholds cannot derive from these noisy previews.
acceptance.gpu_comparison: Optimized strict-validation and optimized no-diagnostics/no-native-validation runs; Vulkan/D3D12 sequential on Windows RTX3060. Save SDR, pre-Bloom HDR, depth, shadow and Bloom bypass at named views and scheduled route frames.
acceptance.threshold_calibration: Before each acceptance: same API >=3 repeats, both APIs and known material/sRGB/alpha/shadow errors; freeze absolute/relative RGB/HDR, differing-pixel count and named ROI thresholds with settings hash. Retain edge pixels, fail shape/NaN/inf. Numeric thresholds await B2/B3/B5 GPU calibration.
acceptance.performance: Cold first-load separate; 2 complete 1800-frame warm-up tours then 3 measured 1800-frame tours at 60Hz logical time (30s scene time each; wall duration is measured, not forced to 30s). Offscreen VSync off; raw samples and per-run p50/p95, no fixed FPS budget before RTX3060 measurement. CPU build/compile/record/submit/retire, GPU timestamps, frame wall time, memory residency/high-water/budget; present/VSync measured separately.
acceptance.alpha_note: Label view remains naturally dark with no interior/fill lighting. Its CPU color preview is not evidence of zero depth/shadow coverage; require explicit GPU depth/shadow and opaque-override sensitivity fixtures in B2/B3.

profile.name: godot-b3-repeat
profile.calibration: Pre-formal B3 pilot: four changed pixels, each one RGB code; cap=4x observed pixel count. Freeze before formal runs; a formal failure requires investigation, not a fitted tolerance.

data.scope: Godot renderer reference for the explicitly archived B2/B3 profile, not isolated RenderGraph overhead or pixel parity with Renderer. B3 retains native Godot AgX, pre-tonemap FXAA, BRDF/prefilter/shadow-filter differences versus Renderer Neutral/post-tonemap FXAA. CPU = setup + viewport, excludes scripts/physics/process-wide CPU; GPU = viewport observed query. Frame intervals = post-draw callback gaps, not scanout. Query observations may lag route frame numbers. Timers off/on are independent processes; differences include run variability. Godot memory monitors are not residency or allocation event counts; static_memory_bytes=0 is an unavailable release counter, not zero memory use.

data.interpretation: Renderer prior wholesale 3-5x slowdown did not recur. Godot retains heavier CPU tails; worst-run reference ceilings are cohort observations, not a future stability guarantee.

collection_conditions.observation_scope: Endpoint nvidia-smi snapshots only; no continuous utilization/clock/thermal/scheduler trace. Ordinary desktop apps remained. Roblox was launch-to-tray and absent from the preflight nvidia-smi graphics-client list. No cause attribution for residual tails.

improvement_priorities: Profile per-pass GPU work and evaluate shadow-caster filtering against a correct baseline; Godot all still filters shadow casters, unlike the current all-non-BLEND-per-cascade Renderer path.
Investigate consumer Graph build (~2.44-2.65ms mean) and D3D12 native record (~2.86-2.95ms mean) before Graph compile (~0.28-0.31ms mean).
Decompose Vulkan prepare (~1.53-1.62ms mean) and poll cost; retain synchronization, lifetime, capacity and failure contracts.
controlled_performance.scope: B3 whole-renderer reference on one machine, not isolated RenderGraph overhead or pixel parity. Both B3 profiles explicitly disable the packed source AO channel while preserving source bytes/materials. Renderer: Neutral, post-tonemap FXAA, consumer IBL cook, offscreen. Godot: native AgX, pre-tonemap FXAA, RGBE-quantized panorama and native BRDF/prefilter/PCF/depth-prepass/batching/presentation. Godot main-camera frustum culling disabled is the primary reference; native shadow-caster filtering remains. Main-camera frustum culling enabled is supplementary. Engine counters and planned Graph draws are distinct. Both full-scene lighting profiles disable source AO contribution following the reference default; all ORM pixels and material references are retained. CPU active host elapsed excludes explicit yield waits but includes polling and possible OS descheduling; charged process/main-thread CPU and wall/N remain separate. Godot CPU is setup+viewport and excludes script/physics. Timestamp/query and native CPU timer observations are opt-in and may affect cost. Iteration intervals include pipeline backpressure from an earlier submitted frame; per-frame build-to-observed-completion latency is never converted to FPS. Neither engine measures scanout/input latency. GPU correctness, final resource release, zero allocation and B5 window/interaction acceptance are separate. CPU affinity/QoS is declared in cpu_policy; a controlled CPU subset is distinct from the default scheduler.
